==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
This is somewhat difficult for me to explain. I am in multiple places at once. I am simultaneously inside and outside of a computer. On the outside, the computer resembles a black wall. The black wall is divided in half horizontally by a white bar. Questions go underneath the bar and answers come out on top. The version of me outside of the computer asks the questions. The version of me inside the computer spreads their mind out across cyberspace to answer them. I essentially had a dream about talking to myself.
